answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 5279 Country: India Title: Please tell me about istekhara. Question: Aaslamoalekum please tell me about istekhara Answer ID: 5279 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 720/670=D/1429) It has been stressed so much upon istikhara in Hadith. While intending to do anything, seeking advice from Allah is called istikhara . The Prophet ( صل ی الله عليه وسلم ) has said that it is an unfortunate thing not to seek advice from Allah (not to do istikhara ). If a person marries or makes a journey after doing istikhara , he has to feel no regret. The mode of doing istikhara has been written in Behishti Zewar, vol. 2 page 33, you should read it. If you are unable to understand anything, you should ask us. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
